title: Residency - active without subject enrollment (reference)
story: Nicolas Valdez is a Master of Arts in Education student in the writing stage who is not enrolled in any subject this semester. Residency keeps such a student active while he completes allowed academic work. It is separate from AWOL, Leave of Absence, withdrawal and completed standing.

Graduate School Staff open **Record residency** on the **AWOL & Residency** board, pick the student, choose a handbook purpose and the semester, run the residency policy checker and, when the checker clears the case, record the residency. There is no staff override: the handbook has none, so if the checker says a case needs human review the **Record residency** button stays disabled and staff fix the record or use Leave of Absence instead. Nicolas's demo record has no missing course-audit subjects, so the checker clears him.
accounts: Residency checker and record on AWOL & Residency
data: Nicolas Valdez, 2691101, MAED (demo group AWOL & Residency)
Thesis / dissertation work (other choices: Practicum / internship completion, Comprehensive examination, Awaiting research publication)
Thesis writing continues without subject enrollment; adviser confirmed progress this semester.

parts.title: Part A - Check and record the Residency
parts.intro: Nicolas's demo record is reset first (the Reset button for him in the Demo accounts panel on the sign-in page, group AWOL & Residency; see {case:reset-demo}).

steps.text: Sign in as **staff@usls.edu.ph** and open **AWOL & Residency** under **Standalone Processes**. The page has the buttons **How this works** and **View recent activity**, a collapsed panel **Rules applied on this screen**, a summary line with the counts per column, the button **Record residency**, the search and filters, and the **Board** / **Table** toggle. The board runs left to right (AWOL, Return review, With the Dean, Re-enrollment, Back in the program, Not approved, Residency, Residency closed); the two residency columns are at the far right.

shots.caption: AWOL & Residency board with the Record residency button.

steps.text: Select **Record residency**. A window opens with a warning (**AWOL cannot be declared manually**) and the fields **Student**, **Residency purpose**, **Semester** and **Staff notes**. In the student box (placeholder: Search all students by name, number, or program) type Valdez and select **Nicolas Valdez**; the box turns into **Selected student**. Choose the purpose **Thesis / dissertation work**, check the semester **AY 2026-2027 1st Semester** and type the staff note.

shots.caption: Record residency window with Nicolas selected.

steps.text: Select **Run residency policy checker**. The residency policy review appears under the form with the result **Eligible for Residency** (Suggested: Record Residency) and three checks, each marked Pass: **No subject enrollment**, **Permitted residency purpose** (the course audit has 0 missing or incomplete subjects) and **Not an LOA substitute**. The button **Record residency** in the window footer is now active.

shots.caption: Residency policy review inside the window: Eligible for Residency, three checks passed (window enlarged to show all of it).

steps.text: Select **Record residency** in the window. The page confirms **Saved. The student record, queue, and monitoring indicators were updated.** and the summary line gains one Residency.

parts.title: Part B - Where the record shows

steps.text: Type Nicolas in the board search. His card is in the **Residency** column (Active no-subject residency semesters): Nicolas Valdez, 2691101 · MAED, the purpose, the semester, Next: Graduate School Staff and the chip **Eligible for Residency**. Select **View details**: the window shows the title **Residency active**, the tracker (**Residency recorded**, **Residency closed**), the request (student, type Residency, semester, purpose, policy result, date recorded, staff notes) and the policy check, with the buttons **Close details** and **Close the residency**. This walkthrough does not close the residency.
Open **Students** and search Valdez. The directory row shows Nicolas with the stage Writing, enrollment **Residency**, standing **Active** and the compre exam result Passed.

shots.caption: Students directory after the Residency was recorded.

notes: Residency is an active no-subject enrollment state for approved academic work. A student with remaining course units who will stop studying should use Leave of Absence instead; the third check, Not an LOA substitute, says so.

The checker decides: residency is recorded only when it returns Eligible for Residency. If a student's course audit still has missing subjects the checker asks for human review and the Record residency button stays disabled (the handbook has no staff override).
The Residency case window can also be closed when the period ends (Close the residency); that was not done in this walkthrough.
